name: pf-debate
description: Public Forum debate partner: PF knowledge, a card library, verbatim card cutting, caselist scouting, and Verbatim speech docs.
long_description: Turns Claude into a Public Forum debate partner. Search a library of already-cut cards (OpenCaselist), cut new cards from any article with a verbatim-only check, build cases, blocks and speeches, scout opponents on OpenCaselist, and export Verbatim-compatible .docx speech docs. First use: ask Claude to "build the quick card library".

tabroom_username.title: Tabroom email (optional)
tabroom_username.description: Only needed for OpenCaselist scouting. Leave blank to skip.

tabroom_password.title: Tabroom password (optional)
tabroom_password.description: Stored securely by Claude Desktop and used only to log in to OpenCaselist.
